user.title: Xiaodu Smart - Login
user.description:
Enter the BDUSS Cookie value of your Xiaodu account.

How to get it:
1. Visit the Xiaodu web version in your browser and log in
2. Press F12 to open DevTools -> Application -> Cookies
3. Find the BDUSS field, copy its value and paste it below
